channel.title: Our Favourite Places Yorkshire Events
channel.description: Upcoming Yorkshire events from Our Favourite Places.

item.title: Spook Show & Film
item.description: Step back in time to the golden age of the traditional Spook Show – an eerie theatrical experience inspired by the mysterious shows that entertained audiences in theatres from the 1920s onwards.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: People’s Emergency Briefing
item.description: What’s happening with climate and nature, and what does it mean for everyday life in the UK? Join the University of Sheffield Allotment Society for a screening of an eye-opening film bringing together leading UK scientists and experts.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: October Half Term Activities
item.description: Come along to Sheffield Manor Lodge this October half term for spooky Halloween craft and trail activities.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: S*Glass, Ian Francis Keye, Marc Matter
item.description: S*Glass creates live mixes of pre-processed noises, appropriated and found sound, disembodied voices, loops and location recordings. Marc Matter (works between sound and language. And ​Ian Francis Keye (Murphy) plays the MPC2000 sampler/sequencer.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Greentop’s October Half Term Holiday Circus Clubs
item.description: Discover a world of aerials, acrobatics, juggling, creativity and performance at Greentop’s holiday circus clubs.
item.location: Greentop Community Circus Centre, St Thomas Building, 74 Holywell Road, S4 8AS
item.ify:location: Greentop Community Circus Centre, St Thomas Building, 74 Holywell Road, S4 8AS

item.title: Elevate x Algorave 5
item.description: Elevate brings an evening of experimental dance music and live-coding to Kelham Island's Factory Floor.
item.location: Factory Floor, 92 Burton Rd, Neepsend, S3 8BX
item.ify:location: Factory Floor, 92 Burton Rd, Neepsend, S3 8BX

item.title: The Witching Tale, Jan Doyle Band & The Greystone Sisters
item.description: A mysterious, spellbinding Halloween show at the Samuel Worth Chapel, featuring The Witching Tale.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: WTF: Audition [4K Restoration]
item.description: This disturbing Japanese thriller follows Aoyama (Ryo Ishibashi), a widower who decides to start dating again. Aided by a film-producer friend (Miyuki Matsuda), Aoyama uses auditions for a fake production to function as a dating service.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
item.description: A cult classic like no other, with wild characters, elaborate dances and memorable songs. Stranded on an isolated road, a young couple find shelter with scientist Dr Frank-N-Furter and discover his latest creation – Rocky Horror, the ultimate man.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Tim Burton’s Universe by Mystery Ensemble
item.description: What better way to celebrate Halloween than an evening of the weird, wonderful and slightly macabre sounds of Tim Burton’s longtime collaborator Danny Elfman. With music from The Nightmare Before Christmas, Edward Scissorhands, Beetlejuice and more.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Cemetery Fungi Walk
item.description: Step into the fascinating world of fungi with a guided walk through the Cemetery, led by expert Ziggy. Discover the variety of mushrooms and toadstools that thrive in this historic landscape and learn more about their role in the natural world.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Pitchblack Playback Premiere: Steven Wilson's Requiem For A Village
item.description: Immerse yourself in an exclusive pre-release playback of Steven Wilson's stunning new album at Pitchblack Playback's listening session in the dark.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: The Devils
item.description: In 17th-century France, a charismatic priest defies a Cardinal's consolidation of power. A prescient vision of obsession and corruption, censored for over half a century, director Ken Russell's landmark film returns in a 55th anniversary restoration.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Sheffield Print Fair
item.description: Enjoy watching printmaking in action and pick up a print or two to take home from among the 43 stalls featuring the wares of artists and printmakers from Sheffield and beyond. Call for applications open till 30 August 2026.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Scooby-Doo Double Bill
item.description: This Halloween, join the Showroom on Spooky Island and in Coolsville for the ultimate double-bill, Scooby-Doo and Scooby-Doo 2: Monsters Unleashed.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Halloween Big Band Boogie
item.description: A free family-friendly jazz gig with a 20-piece band, live singers, and Halloween classics.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Big Fish Little Fish Halloween Family Rave
item.description: It's time to do the Monster Mash rave style. Bring your little ghouls to Big Fish Little Fish's Halloween party – helping parents be responsibly irresponsible since 2013.
item.location: The Steamworks, 109-111 Randall Street, Highfield, S2 4SJ
item.ify:location: The Steamworks, 109-111 Randall Street, Highfield, S2 4SJ
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: The Filing Cabinet of Fear
item.description: Author Richard Daniels presents an entertaining journey into an alternate realm of conspiracies, ghosts, and UFOs. Taken from his case file series, Occultaria of Albion, Richard uses audio and video to deliver a potent, mysterious show.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Pan's Labyrinth
item.description: Blurring the line between reality and fantasy, director Guillermo del Toro depicts the horrors of war against a child's innocence and imagination. A beautiful and terrifying dark fairy tale, back in cinemas with a 20th anniversary 4K restoration.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Queer East - On the Road 2026
item.description: Founded in 2020 with the aim of elevating queer and Asian voices in the UK, Queer East has become one of the most important activities in the country’s cultural calendar.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: The Void: A Horror Story
item.description: Dare you enter a world infected by fear? The Void is a sci-fi horror created for the stage, presented by Yorkshire company Thunder Road.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Mariam sings Amadou & Mariam
item.description: Hear Mariam’s vibrant, Malian, worldbeat music on the Octagon stage.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Sharrow Young Leaders presents... Good Burger
item.description: Showroom's BHM season closes with a celebration of young Black creativity and community. Good Burger (1997) is a comedy about two goofy high-school friends who take summer jobs at a local burger joint and try save it from being taken over by a chain.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Reframing the Lens: spotlight on contemporary Japanese Women Filmmakers
item.description: A two-day event focusing on women in Japanese cinema, including screenings, filmmaker Q&A's, and an optional workshop.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Festival of the Mind
item.description: A biennial festival of new ideas. Bringing together the city's creative community and its academic minds through exhibitions, talks, screenings, performances and more.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Amy Matthews
item.description: Amy doesn’t get angry and she’s starting to feel left out, so she’s on a quest to feel fury. From what she can discern from the world around her, it appears to be all the rage… literally.
item.location: Foundry, Sheffield Student's Union, Western Bank, S10 2TG
item.ify:location: Foundry, Sheffield Student's Union, Western Bank, S10 2TG
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Elgar Piano Quintet
item.description: Pianist Martin Roscoe joins forces with the Brodskys, a quartet who have been performing for over 50 years to prizes and plaudits around the world.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Sounds of Now: Saxophone & Electronics
item.description: Praised for his “urgently visceral” playing (Tempo), London-based Canadian saxophonist David Zucchi is joined by Robert Laidlow for a programme of innovative works for saxophone and live electronics.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Wild Traditions: Rachel Newton
item.description: Join the award winning singer, harpist and composer in concert at Wild Traditions.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Spotlight: Platoon [40th Anniversary]
item.description: Writer/director Oliver Stone's personal and searing testament to the men who fought the war in Vietnam.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Cemetery Sessions Present Lou Barnell, Stephen Carley & Teddy Hunter
item.description: Join three artists at the atmospheric Samuel Worth Chapel for a night of experimental sound, immersive performance and music that resists easy description.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Kayd Somali Arts presents: Untold Stories Part 2
item.description: A powerful documentary delving into the experiences of the Somali community in Tower Hamlets. Plus two short films exploring the legacy of Somali women in Sheffield and a Q&A with the directors Asma Kabadeh and Hamda Ali.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Chabrol
item.description: A season of classic films from one of France's most iconic directors.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Off-Key
item.description: At a Birmingham grammar bursting with overachievers, political meltdowns, and teenage delusion, best friends Sabrin and Ruqqiyah are free-falling to their futures.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: The Hypochondriac
item.description: Written entirely in rhyme, The Hypochondriac is Roger McGough’s hilarious take on Moliere’s 17th century comic satire of the medical profession. Presented by Sheffield University Drama Society.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Chopin Nocturnes
item.description: "Poet of the piano” Pavel Kolesnikov is one of the world’s most exciting young pianists. Lauded for his amazing ability to cast new light on familiar repertoire, he makes his Music in the Round debut with a tour through Chopin's complete Nocturnes.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: SPO play Mahler, Farrenc and Bottesini
item.description: Sheffield Philharmonic Orchestra play Mahler’s Symphony no.5, Farrenc overture no.2 and Bottesini concerto for double bass.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Endless Love Creative: Winter Makers Market
item.description: Discover artisan craft, contemporary design and beautifully made work from 65 independent makers, set across two floors in the heart of Sheffield.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Day of Dance
item.description: Come and celebrate the joy of dance as part of the Dancing Sheffield project. Including a mass join-in dance in Weston Park, performances, workshops and more.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: WTF: Pink Floyd - The Wall
item.description: A confined but troubled rock star descends into madness as he physically and socially isolates himself from everyone. Screening as part of WTF, Showroom's monthly screening strand celebrating the films that make you say "What The F...ilm"!?
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Kelham Makes: Festive Wreath Making
item.description: Get crafty this Christmas and learn how to create a festive fresh door wreath to take home.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: FFStival: Sheffield’s Female-led Film Festival
item.description: FFStival returns for year three!
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: John Shuttleworth: It's Nice Up North [+Q&A]
item.description: A special, 20th-anniversary screening tour of Graham Fellows’ much loved comedy documentary It’s Nice Up North. Also presented as a tribute to the late Martin Parr, who shot the film.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Doctor Who: The Satan Pit
item.description: Celebrate Doctor Who Day with an exclusive big-screen event marking 20 years of the Tenth Doctor and Rose Tyler.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Online Talk: Jyll Bradley In Conversation with Ben Harman
item.description: In this insightful and thought-provoking conversation, British artist Jyll Bradley will join Ben Harman, Senior Curator of Photography at the National Galleries of Scotland, to talk about her extensive body of photographic work.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: The Words Are Coming
item.description: Showroom's monthly open mic invites writers of all styles are welcome to perform their work.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Northern Lights: A Journey Through Nordic Music
item.description: Join a panel of musicians and experts who will shine a light on some of the composers and music featuring across Northern Lights, Music in the Round's weekend of elemental music from the frozen north.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Northern Lights: Music from Iceland
item.description: A dazzling portrait of contemporary Icelandic music ranging from celebrated glacial works by Anna Thorvaldsdóttir and Oscar-winning Hildur Guðnadóttir, to new arrangements of Björk and Ólafur Arnalds’ haunting music for Broadchurch.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Bob Dylan
item.description: Widely acknowledged as one of the most important figures of the modern day and one of the greatest and most influential songwriters of all time, Bob Dylan has reshaped popular music by elevating lyric writing to a profound literary art form.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Northern Lights: Sibelius & Grieg
item.description: Music in the Round's resident Ensemble 360 performs masterpieces and miniatures for strings and piano by two giants of Nordic classicism.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Northern Lights: Engegård Quartet
item.description: Norway’s multi-award-winning Engegård Quartet brings its customary boldness, energy and freshness to Sheffield in a concert of Mozart, Beethoven and Grieg.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Open Studios and Christmas Market
item.description: Explore inside the historic Portland Works to buy art, ceramics, glass, print, jewellery, textiles and more from the people who make them. With an opportunity to visit studios and share mulled wine and a mince pie with the resident makers.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: ShAFF Retrospective Features – The Best Of 20 Years
item.description: Sheffield Adventure Film Festival first landed at the Showroom in March 2006. To mark this 20th anniversary, the team have crafted a weekend retrospective of some of the festival's very best features and shorts.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Ukrainian Christmas Market
item.description: Celebrate a Ukrainian Christmas with folk songs, handmade gifts, authentic food and more.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Northern Lights: Norwegian Folk
item.description: Formed under the midnight sun in the Lofoten Islands, Norway’s leading string quartet brings the rugged soul of the country to the stage, with arrangements of traditional joiks, haunting psalms and spirited bridal marches.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: Christmas 2026
item.description: From family friendly classics to cult festive titles, Showroom's programme will have something for everyone this winter.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.description: An evening of new short films about British Jewish life.
